basis: KNOX TF maintaining indeterminate meristem cells, off in L1 and determinate lateral organs (in situ Jackson 1994, cited by Xu 2021); in all non-epidermal meta-clusters in Xu 2021 and DE in central zone (c3,c5), cortex and pith in Xu 2025. Broad inner-meristem/ground marker: use as a negative for epidermis and lateral organ (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G017087.

REVIEW: v4/v5 ID not resolved (v3 GRMZM2G372364 was added to AGPv3.31 by Xu 2021 Table S4; absent from the MaizeGDB v3->v4/v5 crosswalk, UniProt and Ensembl name search); map by hand. CLV3 ortholog marking shoot stem cells: Molecular Cartography in IM/SPM tips and 1,208 CLE7+ cells in clusters 3/5 (Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell); not detected in Xu 2021.

WUSCHEL ortholog (organizing center); 112 WUS1+ cells inside the central-zone clusters in Xu 2025 (Fig 1C) but not cluster-DE, no spatial probe; not reported in Xu 2021. Very low expression: expect few positive cells (Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G047448. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): bin50 DE in the IM-tip domain in all 3 sections; Stereo-seq compared with the Chen 2021 in situ (Supp Data 1 p16), but the paper labels WUS1 as Zm00001eb067340 (UniProt: C3H1 zinc finger), a figure ID error; use 067310 (homeobox). Not raised: 25 um bins cannot place it in the OC rather than the CZ, and expression stays very low (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

bZIP; fea4 mutant fasciated; second-ranked ZmCLE7 co-expressed gene and DE in SPM central zone c5 (0.56 vs 0.36) in Xu 2025; conflict: Xu 2021 Table S1 lists it enriched in MC3,4,8 (lateral organ, xylem, pith), so not CZ-specific (Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G133331. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): bin50 DE in the IM-tip domain in all 3 sections and the Stereo-seq map matches the published fea4 in situ (Pautler 2015; Supp Data 1 p15); confidence raised low -> medium. The Xu 2021 MC3/4/8 enrichment conflict remains (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

LONELY GUY cytokinin-activating enzyme (UniProt: cytokinin riboside 5-monophosphate phosphoribohydrolase); co-expressed with ZmCLE7 and DE in IM central zone c3 (0.38 vs 0.15) in Xu 2025 only (Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G059392. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): bin50 Stereo-seq DE in the IM-tip domain in all 3 sections (log2FC 3.2-3.9); independent spatial support, confidence raised low -> medium. Bin50 (25 um) cannot separate CZ from apical L1 (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

AP2/ERF TF (UniProt v5: EREB151) with bd1 mutant phenotype; enriched only in meta-cluster 9 (Xu 2021 Table S1) and boundary in situ (Chuck 2002, cited); boundary domain by Molecular Cartography (Xu 2025 Fig 1D). Low expression, not in either DE list; Xu 2025 has no boundary cluster (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G307119. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): Stereo-seq matches the Chuck 2002 in situ (Supp Data 1 p12); DE in the ME/MI domains in all sections. Stays high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

Myo-inositol phosphate synthase; boundary in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2B), DE meta-cluster 9 only. Conflict: in Xu 2025 DE only weakly in cortex and pith (0.87-0.90 vs 0.75) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G004528.

Glutathione transferase; boundary in situ plus a vascular trace (Xu 2021 Fig 2C), DE meta-clusters 9 and 12. Conflict: Xu 2025 DE in lateral-organ epidermis c10 (0.83 vs 0.29), meristem base and lateral organ, so not boundary-specific (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G097989.

bHLH required for axillary meristem initiation (ba1 mutant; in situ Gallavotti 2004, cited); enriched only in meta-cluster 11 (Xu 2021 Table S1); DE in adaxial periphery c12 (0.53 vs 0.11) and meristem base c6 in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v4 crosswalk also lists Zm00001d042988. v3 GRMZM2G397518. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): Stereo-seq pattern matches the literature in situ (Supp Data 1 p13); DE in the DLO domain (not the paper's AMP cluster). Stays high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

Polyamine oxidase; in situ in the BA1 domain (Xu 2021 Fig 2E), DE meta-cluster 11 only; DE only in c12 in Xu 2025 (0.20 vs 0.015). Sparse: few cells positive (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G034152.

DI19-domain protein (uncharacterized); in situ in the BA1 domain (Xu 2021 Fig 2D), DE meta-cluster 11. Xu 2025: weakly DE in c12 (0.95 vs 0.80) and more in c10/c2, so broad in that dataset (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G038284.

NAC (CUC3-like); in situ adaxial periphery (Xu 2021 Fig S3A), DE meta-cluster 11. Conflict: Xu 2025 DE in lateral-organ epidermis c10 (0.82 vs 0.24), c9 and meristem base, not c12 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G430522.

ACC oxidase (UniProt auto-name ACO1); adaxial meristem periphery by Molecular Cartography (Xu 2025 Fig 1D) and DE c12 (0.41 vs 0.12); not DE in Xu 2021, so single-study (Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G007249.

Uncharacterized protein; DE only in meta-cluster 11 (Xu 2021 Table S1) and only in c12 (Xu 2025; log2FC 2.4, 0.37 vs 0.19). Agreement across the two datasets (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G430807. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): in situ on the IM periphery (Supp Data 1 p5, called IMP) and top DE gene of the mislabeled DLO domain (= RA/BA1 domain) in S1S2; validated in Wang and cluster-specific in both Xu datasets, so evidence -> characterized_enriched and confidence raised medium -> high. Domain names differ between studies (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

Trehalose-6-phosphate phosphatase (UniProt Q1W5S8, reviewed) controlling spikelet-pair meristem determinacy; in situ at the meristem base (Satoh-Nagasawa 2006, cited); enriched MC10/11 (Xu 2021); DE only in meristem base c6 (0.11 vs 0.03) and meristem base by Molecular Cartography in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G014729. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): Stereo-seq matches the literature in situ (Supp Data 1 p17); DE in DLO (log2FC 3.2), which is the RA domain. Stays high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

C2H2 zinc-finger TF (UniProt Q4U4A8 Ramosa1); ra1 mutant; in situ at the SPM base (Vollbrecht 2005, cited); enriched MC10 and MC11 (Xu 2021), not DE in Xu 2025. Reported only in Andropogoneae (maize, sorghum), not rice (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G003927. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): Stereo-seq matches the Vollbrecht 2005 in situ (Supp Data 1 p17) and DE in the DLO (= RA) domain (log2FC 3.3); independent spatial validation, confidence raised medium -> high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

LOB-domain TF (UniProt Q27YF3 Ramosa2); ra2 mutant; in situ (Bortiri 2006, cited); enriched MC9,10,11 (Xu 2021), so also boundary/adaxial periphery; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 AC233943.1_FG002. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): Stereo-seq matches the Bortiri 2006 in situ (Supp Data 1 p17) and DE in the DLO (= RA) domain (log2FC 2.8); independent spatial validation, confidence raised medium -> high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

Pep1 peptide precursor; meristem L1 in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 3), DE meta-cluster 6 only; Xu 2025 DE in meristem epidermis c2 (0.86 vs 0.14) and dividing epidermis c8/c11, not lateral-organ epidermis. UniProt entry uncharacterized; v5 ID confirmed by the Xu 2025 table (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM5G899080. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): DE in the ME domain in all 3 Stereo-seq sections (log2FC 2.1-2.4; also IMP/IMT); consistent. Stays high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

HD-ZIV (ATML1/PDF2 family) L1 TF; L1 in situ (Javelle 2011, cited); enriched MC3,6 (Xu 2021); DE in all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (0.72-0.77 vs 0.14-0.18) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G122897.

HD-ZIV L1 TF; epidermal ZmHDZIV6-YFP reporter (Xu 2021 Fig S4I); DE in epidermal clusters c2,c10,c11 in Xu 2025 (0.64-0.76 vs 0.13-0.18) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G001289.

HD-ZIV OUTER CELL LAYER4; DE in meta-cluster 3 (Xu 2021) and in all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (0.82-0.90 vs 0.24-0.27); single-cell evidence only, raised by agreement (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G123140.

HD-ZIV TF; DE in meta-cluster 3 (Xu 2021) and in all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (0.77-0.89 vs 0.16-0.20); single-cell evidence only, raised by agreement (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G118063.

MFS18 glycine-rich protein; L1 in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2F), DE MC3,6; DE in all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (0.85-0.91 vs 0.17-0.21) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 EF517601.1_FG016.

Non-specific lipid-transfer protein; L1 in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2G), DE MC3,6; DE in all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (log2FC 3.1 in c2). Symbol clash: UniProt calls this gene LTP3, but Xu 2021 Table S1 uses ltp3 for GRMZM5G898755 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G126397.
Aquaporin NIP1-1 (UniProt Q9ATN4, reviewed); epidermal in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 3), DE MC3; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G041980.

3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase (cuticular wax/VLCFA; uncharacterized in maize); DE MC3,6 (Xu 2021) and all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (0.97 vs 0.25); raised by agreement (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G445602.

3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase (cuticular wax/VLCFA; uncharacterized in maize); DE MC3,6 (Xu 2021) and all four epidermal clusters in Xu 2025 (0.90 vs 0.18); raised by agreement (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G162508. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): in situ in SPM/SM L1 (Fig 1e, Supp Data 1 p2) and DE in ME in 3 Stereo-seq sections; first in situ for this gene, so evidence -> characterized_enriched and confidence raised medium -> high (validated in Wang, cluster-specific in Xu 2021 and Xu 2025). Pan-L1/epidermal, so it also marks Meristem_Epidermis; kcs15 = this ID is inferred from the matching images (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

YABBY TF; pYAB14-TagRFPt reporter, FACS RNA-seq (AUROC 0.8 against MC3 DE genes) and ATAC (Xu 2021 Fig 2N-R); determinate lateral organ by Molecular Cartography (Xu 2025 Fig 1D). Not in either DE table. UniProt auto-name YABBY 5 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G005353.
YABBY DROOPING LEAF2 (Strable 2017, cited); marks the adaxial subcluster of MC3 (Xu 2021 Fig S2A) and enriched MC3,9; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G102218.

YABBY (YAB3 homolog; UniProt name Yabby15); top YABBY in the YAB14-reporter FACS RNA-seq (Xu 2021 Fig 2O) and DE MC3; DE in lateral-organ clusters c9/c10 in Xu 2025 (0.41-0.44 vs 0.09) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G529859. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): called Yabby15 (Chen 2021 naming, as UniProt); Stereo-seq matches the Chen 2021 in situ in determinate lateral organs (Supp Data 1 p16) and DE in ME in 3 sections (ME contains lateral-organ primordia); independent spatial validation, confidence raised medium -> high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).
FLOWERING PROMOTING FACTOR1-like (UniProt FLP1); lateral-organ in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2H), DE MC3; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G019686.

BLADE-ON-PETIOLE (UniProt NPR5, BOP clade), lateral-organ fate; in situ (Xu 2021 Fig S3J), MC3-enriched; not DE in Xu 2025. v5 crosswalk also gives Zm00001eb196460 (uncharacterized) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G026556.

GATA TF tasselsheath1 (mutant phenotype per Xu 2021 Table S1), suppressed-bract regulator; enriched only in MC3 (Xu 2021) and DE in lateral organ c9 (0.46 vs 0.22) in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G325850.

Plantacyanin; lateral-organ in situ (Xu 2021 Fig S3J), DE MC3. Conflict: in Xu 2025 DE in all four epidermal clusters with high background (0.86-0.96 vs 0.55) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G004012.

CER1 alkane-forming aldehyde decarbonylase (cuticular wax); lateral-organ in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2I), DE MC3. Conflict: in Xu 2025 DE only in meristem epidermis c2 (0.79 vs 0.43); likely an epidermal (wax) gene within lateral organs (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G075255.

bHLH TMO5-LIKE3; in situ in xylem (Xu 2021 Fig 2J) but also the meristem tip (Fig S3D); DE MC4; DE only in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.65 vs 0.11). v5 split: crosswalk gives Zm00001eb099400 (Xu 2025 table) and Zm00001eb099390 (UniProt bHLH); both rows kept (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G176141. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): DE in Vas in 2 Stereo-seq sections (log2FC 2.1-2.3); the in situ probe was named by the 099390 model. Stays high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

Second v5 model of TMO5-LIKE3 (UniProt: bHLH domain protein); see the Zm00001eb099400 row; keep whichever is expressed in the data (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G176141. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): Wang uses this v5 model: in situ in vascular strands (Supp Data 1 p8) and DE in Vas in 3 sections; second independent in situ, confidence raised medium -> high. 099400 is also Vas-DE (2 sections), so both models are supported (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

WALLS ARE THIN1-related transporter; xylem in situ (Xu 2021 Fig S3C) but also the meristem tip (Fig S3F); DE MC4; DE only in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.25 vs 0.03) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G007953.
Amino acid transporter; xylem in situ (Xu 2021 Fig S3B), also meristem tip (Fig S3E); DE MC4; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G109865.

bHLH TMO5 ortholog (xylem-specifying in Arabidopsis); UMAP in MC4 (Xu 2021 Fig 1J), DE MC4; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G043854. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): DE in Vas in all 3 Stereo-seq sections (log2FC 1.3-3.9; also the S3 IMT domain, which carries vascular genes); vasculature-level agreement with Xu 2021 MC4 (as for ZNF30 with Xu 2025 c13), confidence raised low -> medium (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

Secondary-wall MYB46 (UniProt G3M8E6), the secondary-wall switch of tracheary elements (function from Arabidopsis); marks the maturing xylem subcluster of MC4 (Xu 2021 Fig S2B); not DE in Xu 2025. v4 crosswalk also gives Zm00001d023931 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G052606. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): bin50 DE in Vas (2 sections); vasculature-level only, not raised (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

WAT1-related protein (uncharacterized); DE only in MC4 xylem (Xu 2021) and the top marker of vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (log2FC 3.5, 0.79 vs 0.04) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM5G804575.

ALTERED PHLOEM DEVELOPMENT ortholog (MYB-related GARP; UniProt GLK53), phloem identity in Arabidopsis; UMAP in MC5 (Xu 2021 Fig 1K), enriched but not DE; not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G052544. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): bin50 DE only in Vas (2 sections, no other domain above 0.3); vasculature-level only (no phloem split), so not raised (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

RanBP2 zinc-finger protein; phloem in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2K), DE MC5; DE in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.34 vs 0.15), which does not separate xylem and phloem (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G116079. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): second independent in situ in vascular strands of rachis and glumes (Fig 1f); DE in Vas in 3 sections (Wang does not split xylem and phloem). Stays high (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).
Dof TF, PEAR1/2 ortholog (protophloem sieve element in Arabidopsis); marks a MC5 subcluster (Xu 2021 Fig S2C); not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G093725.
PHLOEM PROTEIN 2-LIKE A1; marks a MC5 subcluster (Xu 2021 Fig S2C); not DE in Xu 2025 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G073693.

GRAS SHORT-ROOT1; called the bundle sheath marker (MC12, Xu 2021 Fig 1L, enriched not DE); DE only in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.37 vs 0.01) and strands along the vasculature by Molecular Cartography (Fig 1D, labelled bundle sheath). A Kranz sheath is unlikely in a 5-10 mm ear; read as vascular sheath. v5 crosswalk also gives Zm00001eb020840 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G132794. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): bin50 DE in Vas in all sections; the sheath is not resolved at 25 um, not raised (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).

GRAS SHORT-ROOT1-like1 (UniProt GRAS19); DE in MC4 and MC12 (Xu 2021) and only in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.85 vs 0.08); may also mark xylem-side cells (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G172657.

Endoglucanase (UniProt Cel21); a top MC12 marker (Xu 2021 Fig 2A, DE MC12 only) and DE only in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.71 vs 0.04) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G009025.
Uncharacterized protein; DE MC12 only (Xu 2021) and only in vasculature c13 in Xu 2025 (0.89 vs 0.15) (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G140739.

Lipid-transfer/proline-rich protein (homolog of an Arabidopsis root-cortex gene); UMAP in MC1 (Xu 2021 Fig 1M); not DE in Xu 2025. The MC1 cortex call has no in situ (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G345700. Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): conflict: not cortex-DE in Wang (log2FC 0.55 in Cortex; higher in AMP and S4 Vas/IMT). Stays low (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants).
G2-like MYB (UniProt GLK23); UMAP in MC8 (Xu 2021 Fig S2D); not DE in Xu 2025. The MC8 pith call has no in situ (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G039074.

Acyltransferase (CGI-58 homolog); top MC8 marker (Xu 2021 Fig 2A) and DE only in pith c4 in Xu 2025, but with high background (0.97 vs 0.78), so not raised (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G079109.

Uncharacterized protein; top MC8 marker (Xu 2021 Fig 2A) and DE only in pith c4 in Xu 2025, with high background (0.92 vs 0.78). v5 crosswalk also gives Zm00001eb129760 (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G151807.

B-type cyclin (G2/M); punctate in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2L), DE MC2; DE in both G2/M clusters c7,c11 in Xu 2025 (0.67-0.72 vs 0.09-0.15). State, not a type (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G061287.

Replication-dependent histone H2A; in situ (Xu 2021 Fig 2M), DE MC7; DE in S-phase clusters c0,c8 in Xu 2025 (log2FC 2.2-2.6, but background 0.83-0.85). State, not a type (Xu et al. 2021 Dev Cell; Xu et al. 2025 Dev Cell). v3 GRMZM2G305046.

MADS-box TF; whole determinate spikelet/floral meristem dome, absent from the IM tip, by in situ (Fig 2c, Supp Data 1 p9); CR-Zmmads8/14 double mutant turns florets into branches (loss of determinacy); Stereo-seq DE only in the ME domain in 3 sections. Marks SM and FM together, not floral organ primordia. Symbol conflict: Entrez 541985 calls this gene MADS14; compare by ID (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

MADS-box TF; same SM/FM dome in situ (Fig 2d, Supp Data 1 p9) and the same double-mutant phenotype as ZmMADS8; DE only in the ME domain in 3 sections. Adjacent to DRL1 (Zm00001eb008680); do not confuse (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

NARROW SHEATH1 (UniProt Q70UV1, WOX3A), recruits lateral-domain founder cells; in situ in outer cells at SPM/SM flanks (Supp Data 1 p3); DE in ME/IMT. Marks the lateral L1 domain, not all of L1 (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

Asparagine synthetase (UniProt A0A804LIJ1); in situ in IM L1 at the tip and flanks (Supp Data 1 p1); DE in ME in 2 sections (S1S2, S4) (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

OUTER CELL LAYER1 HD-ZIP IV; RNA in situ restricted to the L1 of meristems and young epidermis (Ingram et al. 2000 Plant J; survey characterized_markers.tsv). Not a Wang review marker, but its top Stereo-seq DE is the ME domain in all 3 sections (log2FC 2.5-2.8, also IMT): independent agreement with the literature in situ. Not seen in the Xu tables; may also mark lateral-organ epidermis (Ingram et al. 1999) (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

Ser/Thr protein kinase (UniProt A0A804QF96); in situ in IM L1 (Supp Data 1 p6), but its top S1S2 DE is the Cortex domain, which conflicts (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

AP2/ERF domain protein (UniProt A0A804LJ76); in situ at the SM tips (Supp Data 1 p1), but its top DE is the IM-tip domain in all 3 sections (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

Aquaporin PIP2-5 (UniProt Q9XF58); in situ in the IM apex dome (Supp Data 1 p3); DE in IMT/IM in S4 only. Not a stem-cell gene; the IM-tip domain includes apical L1 (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.
NAC domain TF (UniProt A0A804PRZ8); in situ at the IM apex (Supp Data 1 p5); DE in IMT in 3 sections but also ME and DLO (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

Uncharacterized (UniProt A0A804NJQ1); in situ in the central core under the IM (inner IM / rib zone; Supp Data 1 p4); DE in the IM domain in 3 sections, also Pith-1 in S3. Inner meristem, not epidermis (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

C-class AGAMOUS ortholog ZAG1 (NCBI Gene 542244 = LOC542244, aliases ZAG1/MADS37; UniProt entries uncharacterized). Literature in situ: stamen and carpel primordia and inner floral meristem (Schmidt et al. 1993 Plant Cell; survey characterized_markers.tsv). Conflict: the Wang review graded this ID as Meristem_Epidermis (in situ in the outer layer of the IM apex and SMs, Supp Data 1 p6; DE in IMT and S4 ME) without naming it; that is not the published ZAG1 pattern, so it is not used as an L1 marker. Low until checked in data (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

HD-ZIP class II homeobox (UniProt A0A804MCA9 family); DE only in the Vas domain (S1S2, S4). Class II, not HD-ZIP III, so not a procambium marker. Lineage-level only (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.
CASP-like membrane protein; DE only in the Vas domain (S1S2, S4). Lineage-level only (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

HTH-MYB; DE in Pith-1 in 3 sections and Pith-2 (other domains <= 0.45); the pith label is positional (bin50, imputed), no in situ (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.

4-coumarate-CoA ligase; DE in Pith-2 in 3 sections and Pith-1; lignin pathway, so it may mark differentiating cells inside the rachis; no in situ (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.
Uncharacterized; DE only in the Cortex domain (S1S2, S3); positional label, no in situ (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.
GDP-mannose 4,6-dehydratase; DE only in the Cortex domain (2 sections); positional label, no in situ (Wang et al. 2024 Nat Plants). Update 2026-10-20 (Wang 2024): new row.
